behavior: Source codes open stable public originals; locators open preserved copies when all cited pages are supplied, otherwise the public original. Direct PDF links use the first cited physical page, never the excerpt page number.
portal_behavior: NextRequest document citations open the public viewer. Extracted ZIP-member citations open the source request; exact member names, member/ZIP hashes and unchanged selected pages identify the record. A tested direct-download endpoint returned HTTP 403; no blocked or temporary signed download URL is substituted.
availability: Link targets are derived from the preserved source registry; this manifest is not a fresh availability check of every publisher URL. PDF page jumps depend on the reader.
